newsitem.title: USA: Edison Intl sets oddlot share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Edison Intl sets oddlot share buyback.

text.p: Edison International announced Wednesday a voluntary "oddlot" buyback program for shareholders owning less than 100 shares of Edison stock.
Edison said shareholders of record on January 3 can sell their shares back to the company at the average of New York Stock Exchange closing prices for trading days from January 15 to February 10.
Edison said it will mail eligible shareholders a card and those who choose to participate must mail it back by February 10.
A processing fee of 75 cents per share will be deducted from the shareholder's proceeds.
Shares held in any Edison-sponsored employee benefit plan, or by shareholders participating in Edison's dividend reinvestment plan are excluded from the offer.
